create_colorcal_module: create a Colorcal module with ncams cameras and nident identities for color calibration
run_colorcal_forward: run the Colorcal forward pass on an image tensor with camera and identity indices
build_colorcal_parameters: build learnable camera and identity weight and bias parameters for per-camera color calibration
test_colorcal_calibration: test the Colorcal module by applying per-camera and per-identity color adjustments to an image
review_colorcal_init: review the Colorcal constructor to configure reference camera and identity indices for calibration
